author: nonretail_writer
central_thesis: Falling yields and a weaker dollar have turned the 'Fed is done' story into a broad risk rally: the 10Y closed at 4.42% after a 44 bp bull flattening over 20 observations, the DXY fell 2.07% in five sessions to 103.47 and the VIX sank to 13.41, while Microsoft's hire of Sam Altman re-centred AI leadership ahead of Nvidia's pending Q3 report. The rally now prices soft landing and AI delivery at once, so the edge is owning duration-sensitive assets and quality AI while hedging record hedge-fund crowding, a cautious consumer (Walmart) and a political fight over Poland's central bank.
sources_policy: Facts come only from the 2023-11-21 frozen feed headlines (cited inline as [[nNNNN]] in the same part) and the 2023-11-21 market card; no other date's feed, card, spec or draft, no web resources, and no knowledge of events on or after 2023-11-21. Background knowledge is used only for general mechanisms. Spot-FX numbers are not quoted; currency direction comes from cited headlines; DXY is quoted as an index.
known_ambiguities_omitted: n0075 (ABC, 2023-11-20 08:00): 'Growing signs businesses were passing on cost increases ... prompted latest RBA rate hike' reads like coverage of the RBA November minutes, released 21 Nov 00:30 UTC, i.e. after cutoff; not used, recommended for exclusion.
n1064 (Notebookcheck): 'Nvidia stock soars spectacularly thanks to surging AI demand' could refer to post-results trading on 21-22 Nov; not used.

n1798 (Money.pl): 'Parlament uchwalił budżet na rok 2024 ... rekordowy deficyt' is prefixed 'Wojna w Ukrainie' and most likely concerns Ukraine's parliament, not Poland's; not used for Polish fiscal claims.
n1442 (Reuters): 'Premature to start talking about interest rate cuts' does not name the speaker or central bank; not used.
n1259 'Best Online Mortgage Lenders of February 2024' and n1935 'Best Robo Advisors in 2025' carry later-period titles inconsistent with their timestamps; not used, recommended for exclusion.
Numeric FX levels in Polish headlines (n1887 dollar below 4 zl, n1890 NBP euro fixing, n1775 pound under 5 zl) and the 150-yen level in n2266/n1622 are not quoted; only direction is used.

n0023 (Guardian, timestamp 2023-11-06 08:00) reports the RBA hike to 4.35%, an event dated 7 Nov local time; the timestamp precedes the event (day-granularity artifact) but the decision is well before cutoff, so it is used only for the completed decision.
No dated preview for the FOMC minutes, OPEC+ meeting, RBA minutes or Nvidia's results date was found, so these are described as pending without dates.
